newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average gains more than 100 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average gains more than 100 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 100 points on Monday, building on last Friday's upturn amid Wall Street speculation that the Federal Reserve was likely to keep interest rates stable at next week's policy-setting meeting.
At 1 p.m. EDT, the Dow was up 100.14 points at 7,269.67, which surpassed its May 6 record close of 7,225.32.
